business_summary: Beijing Science Sun Pharmaceutical Co., Ltd., a biopharmaceutical company, engages in the research, development, production, and sale of injections in China. The company offers products for cardiovascular, cerebrovascular, immunomodulation, and nervous systems, and other drugs. It is also involved in raw materials, solid oral preparations, and health products; extraction of traditional Chinese medicine; manufacture of Chinese and Western medicine preparations; research, development, production, and sales of tablets, hard capsules, powders, granules, and active pharmaceutical ingredients; outward investment, technology introduction and exchange, international business development, livestock and poultry production, and research and development of bio-organic fertilizers and bio-feeds. In addition, the company is engaged venture capital; equity investment through private equity funds; technology development, transfer, and services for biological products, pharmaceuticals, diagnostic reagents, and medical devices; biotechnology information consulting; sales of immunoassay reagents and laboratory instruments; research, development and industrialization of human vaccines; investment management and consulting for non-securities businesses, as well as inspection and testing services, consulting services, and health food production. The company was founded in 1999 and is headquartered in Beijing, China.
